row.title: Unlearn tenant: manifest and idea
row.body: Unlearn (curiosity-led learning, Agora model from Bregman's Humankind) is a level-1 tenant: instances/unlearn/{IDEA.md,instance.json,README.md}. Default in effect: the adult (coach or parent) is the user, no child accounts or child data. Measures continuation_14d >= 0.5 and telling_share <= 0.3, both declared until probes exist (README build plan steps 5 and 6).
